description: Send the customer's closet details to Paradise Closets so a designer contacts them with a quote (same as the form on pclosets.com/quote). Only call this when the customer asked to be contacted and agreed to share their details. Requires name, US ZIP, an email or phone, closet type and dimensions.

closet_type.description: Reach-in (one wall) or walk-in (up to three walls)

email.description: Customer email (email or phone is required)

notes.description: Anything else: doors, windows, style, timing

package.description: Premium: dovetail drawers with soft-close, plus crown and base molding. Standard: standard drawers, no crown or base molding.

phone.description: Customer phone, 10+ digits (email or phone is required)

special_color.description: Special color (specialty matte colors, priced from the supplier's specialty level)

wall_a_inches.description: Walk-in: wall A width in inches

wall_b_inches.description: Walk-in: wall B width in inches

wall_c_inches.description: Walk-in: wall C width in inches

width_inches.description: Reach-in: back wall width in inches

zip_code.description: US ZIP code where the closet ships

name: request_quote
title: Request a free closet quote
